_about: Level 60 talent build sources gathered 2026-11-11 for the Talents tab presets. Build codes use the shared per-tree digit format (one digit per talent, ordered by row then column, trailing zeros trimmed, trees joined by '-'). 'wowheadLayout' is the live Forever tree layout read from Wowhead's talent calculator ([row0,col0,maxRank,spellId,slug]) and is used to decode every code. Rebuild the preset data with: node scripts/build-talent-builds-60.mjs

wowhead.name: Wowhead
wowhead.note: Per-spec 'Talent Builds' guides; PvE raid and dungeon builds used.

foreverdb.name: ForeverDB
foreverdb.note: Per-class builds pages; the level-60 group/dungeon build per spec, checked by ForeverDB against client build 1.60.1.70862.

wowforevertalents.name: WoW Forever Talents
wowforevertalents.note: Community public talent links with view and vote counts (51-point builds only).
